verbatims.quote: Honestly I just bet the Chiefs. I'm not reading a bunch of stats first.
The score is the only thing I'd actually look at. Give me a number and I'm good.
A 0 to 100 score that blends ATS and line movement is a pick with extra steps. Show me the raw numbers.
Start Here is nice. I don't really get 'against the spread' but 'won 4 straight' I understand.
I'd ask the analyst about prop matchups if it's quick. If it gives me a wall of text, no thanks.
If the score says 78 and that team gets blown out, I'm deleting the app.
Odds updating a few times a day isn't enough for line movement to mean much on game day.
AI answering betting questions? I'd want to know where it gets its info. Feels like it could make stuff up.

researcher_note: 'None' is the biggest Q1 answer (26%), mostly gut-betting casuals. Score fans are casuals wanting a lean. ~40% trust only if method shown. Start Here highest usefulness; plain English avoids ATS jargon. Analyst last (AI accuracy doubts, typing effort).
